title: 第12课 · 把重要的东西放在我这儿吧
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 12 — 把重要的东西放在我这儿吧 · Leave the important items with me

data.topic: 课上要点 · Class notes (14 Nov 2026)

items.zh: 总览 · What this class was about (14 Nov 2026)
items.en: First half: culture — the 24 solar terms (二十四节气), 立冬 (start of winter, 7 Nov this year), describing winter in the Netherlands, and Chinese winter food (冬补, 麻油鸡). Second half: Lesson 12 — the 把 sentence (把 X 放在 Y), Text 1 (今天太阳从西边出来了吗？), the words 东西南北 / 怎么了 / 这么, 以前 vs 以后, and 就 vs 才. Homework: write 我眼中的冬天.

items.zh: ──────── Part 1 · 二十四节气 and 立冬
items.en: Culture part of the class.

items.zh: 1 · 二十四节气 · The 24 solar terms
items.en: China used to be a farming country (农业国家), and for farming the weather matters, so a month (30 days) is too long: the year is split into 24 terms of about 15 days, two per month. 立春 is number 1. Easy to remember: 立 = 'start', so 立春、立夏、立秋、立冬 = start of spring, summer, autumn, winter. They follow the farmers' calendar, so the date moves a day: this year 立冬 was 7 November (term 19). Compare: 元旦 (1 January) never moves, but 春节 (Spring Festival) follows the moon (农历) — late January or early February.
see: 文化 · Culture (二十四节气 · 立冬 · 冬补)

items.py: lìchūn, lìxià, lìqiū, lìdōng
items.en: start of spring, summer, autumn, winter

items.zh: 二零二六年十一月七日是立冬。
items.py: Èr líng èr liù nián shíyī yuè qī rì shì lìdōng.
items.en: 7 November 2026 was the start of winter.

items.zh: 中国人的新年是按照月亮来计算的。
items.py: Zhōngguórén de xīnnián shì ànzhào yuèliang lái jìsuàn de.
items.en: The Chinese New Year is calculated by the moon.

After 立冬 come 小雪 and 大雪 (little and big snow), then 冬至 (winter solstice: the shortest day and longest night in the northern hemisphere), then 小寒 and 大寒 — the coldest days, around the Spring Festival. In summer it mirrors: 夏至 is the longest day, 小暑 and 大暑 the hottest weeks. 清明 is the day to remember family who passed away.
see: 文化 · Culture (二十四节气 · 立冬 · 冬补)

items.zh: 冬至这一天，白天最短，晚上最长。
items.py: Dōngzhì zhè yì tiān, báitiān zuì duǎn, wǎnshang zuì cháng.
items.en: On the winter solstice the day is shortest and the night longest.

items.zh: 小寒和大寒是最冷的时候。
items.py: Xiǎohán hé dàhán shì zuì lěng de shíhou.
items.en: Little Cold and Great Cold are the coldest time.

Describe what changes after 立冬. 变 + adjective = 'becomes / is getting' — a moving situation, not a fixed one: 白天变短了, 夜晚变长了. The teacher's example: overnight all the leaves fell off the ginkgo tree (银杏树) in her garden.
see: 练习 · Practice (立冬以后 Describing winter)

items.py: Lìdōng yǐhòu yǒudiǎnr lěng le.
items.en: After the start of winter it's getting a bit cold.

items.zh: 白天变短了，夜晚变长了。
items.py: Báitiān biàn duǎn le, yèwǎn biàn cháng le.
items.en: The days are getting shorter and the nights longer.

items.py: Lìdōng yǐhòu dàjiā chuān dōngzhuāng.
items.en: After 立冬 everyone wears winter clothes.

items.zh: 银杏树的叶子一夜之间都落了。
items.py: Yínxìngshù de yèzi yí yè zhī jiān dōu luò le.
items.en: Overnight all the ginkgo leaves fell.

items.zh: 4 · 冬藏 and 冬补 · Storing up and eating well
items.en: Winter is the season of storing (收藏): animals hibernate (冬眠, like snakes; bears half-sleep), and people eat nourishing, warm food (冬补) to build strength for next year — in the old days there was no work on the land in winter. Northerners eat dumplings (饺子); southerners stew meat soups (炖肉汤). A classic is 麻油鸡: fry ginger in sesame oil, add chicken, then rice wine, and stew slowly for about two hours; add red dates (红枣). Ginger keeps you warm. Dutch counterpart: erwtensoep.
see: 文化 · Culture (二十四节气 · 立冬 · 冬补)

items.zh: 冬天要吃得好一点，这叫冬补。
items.py: Dōngtiān yào chī de hǎo yìdiǎnr, zhè jiào dōngbǔ.
items.en: In winter you should eat well — that's called 冬补.

items.zh: 北方人吃饺子，南方人喝肉汤。
items.py: Běifāngrén chī jiǎozi, nánfāngrén hē ròutāng.
items.en: Northerners eat dumplings, southerners drink meat soup.

items.zh: 先用麻油和老姜炒鸡，再加米酒，小火慢慢炖。
items.py: Xiān yòng máyóu hé lǎojiāng chǎo jī, zài jiā mǐjiǔ, xiǎo huǒ mànmàn dùn.
items.en: Fry the chicken with sesame oil and ginger, add rice wine, and stew slowly on a low heat.
Write in your own words: 我眼中的冬天 — winter as you see it. Childhood memories, a winter trip (Norway, Iceland…), winter in China, or winter in the Netherlands.
see: 练习 · Practice (立冬以后 Describing winter)

items.zh: ──────── Part 2 · Lesson 12 · 把重要的东西放在我这儿吧
items.en: Back to the book: the 把 sentence and Text 1.

把 links a person, a thing and what happens to it: 我把水杯给你. Without 把 (我水杯你) there is no connection. Warm-up: say where things go — pencil on the desk, clothes in the wardrobe (or 挂 = hang up), photo on the wall, wallet in your pocket, passport in the drawer. 放在 = put on/in; 挂在 = hang on; 拿出来 = take out.
see: 练习 · Practice (把……放在…… Where to put things)
语法 · Grammar (把字句2：A把B+V+在/到+地方)

items.py: Bǎ qiānbǐ fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
items.en: Put the pencil on the desk.

items.py: Bǎ yīfu guà zài yīguì li.
items.en: Hang the clothes in the wardrobe.

items.py: Bǎ qiánbāo cóng bāo li ná chūlai.
items.en: Take the wallet out of the bag.

items.zh: 请你把包放在旁边，别放在桌子上。
items.py: Qǐng nǐ bǎ bāo fàng zài pángbiān, bié fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
items.en: Please put your bag to the side, not on the table.

items.zh: 6 · 今天太阳从西边出来了吗？
items.en: The sun always rises in the east, so 'did the sun rise in the west today?' is a joking way to show surprise that someone does something they never do. Use it only when it's unusual: if Mum cooks every day, cooking today is nothing special.
see: 练习 · Practice (太阳从西边出来了吗？)
课文1 · 1. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 他平时不做家务，今天把家里打扫干净了。太阳从西边出来了！
items.py: Tā píngshí bú zuò jiāwù, jīntiān bǎ jiā li dǎsǎo gānjìng le. Tàiyáng cóng xībian chūlai le!
items.en: He never does housework, but today he cleaned the house. The sun rose in the west!

items.zh: 一个平时不运动的人今天跑了十公里。
items.py: Yí ge píngshí bú yùndòng de rén jīntiān pǎo le shí gōnglǐ.
items.en: Someone who never exercises ran ten kilometres today.

items.zh: 7 · 东西南北 + 边 · 怎么了 · 这么
items.en: 东 east, 西 west, 南 south, 北 north; add 边 for 'side': 东边、西边、南边、北边. Chinese like a house or garden facing south (朝南) for the sun. 怎么了？ = what's wrong? — when something is different from usual. Surprise about something here and now takes 这么, never 那么: 你怎么这么早？ 你怎么穿得这么少？
see: 练习 · Practice (这么 / 以前 / 以后)

items.py: Tàiyáng cóng dōngbian chūlai.
items.en: The sun rises in the east.

items.py: Mǎi fángzi, yuànzi yào cháo nán.
items.en: When you buy a house, the garden should face south.

items.py: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme zhème zǎo?
items.en: How come you're so early today?

items.py: Nǐ zěnme chuān de zhème shǎo?
items.en: Why are you wearing so little?
On their own, 以前 = in the past and 以后 = in the future. After a time word they mean before / after that time: 十点半以前 = before half past ten, 九点以后 = after nine.
see: 练习 · Practice (这么 / 以前 / 以后)

items.zh: 我以前住在北京，现在住在荷兰。
items.py: Wǒ yǐqián zhù zài Běijīng, xiànzài zhù zài Hélán.
items.en: I used to live in Beijing; now I live in the Netherlands.

items.zh: 我以后每天十点以前睡觉。
items.py: Wǒ yǐhòu měi tiān shí diǎn yǐqián shuì jiào.
items.en: From now on I'll go to bed before ten every day.

items.zh: 请老师们十点半以前到学校。
items.py: Qǐng lǎoshīmen shí diǎn bàn yǐqián dào xuéxiào.
items.en: Teachers, please be at school before half past ten.

items.py: Jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu wǒ huì chǔlǐ.
items.en: I'll deal with it after nine.

The time is a fact; 就 and 才 show how the speaker feels about it. 就 = earlier / faster than expected; 才 = later / slower than expected. A mother who wants her child up: 你十点才起床. A mother who knows her child is tired: 你十点就起床了? Twenty is late to start Chinese for someone with a Chinese mother (二十岁才开始学), but four is early (四岁就开始学).
see: 练习 · Practice (就 vs 才)
语法 · Grammar (才：晚、慢、不顺利)

items.py: Tā shí diǎn cái qǐ chuáng.
items.en: He didn't get up until ten (late).

items.zh: 爷爷早上五点就起床了。
items.py: Yéye zǎoshang wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le.
items.en: Grandpa was up at five already (early).

items.zh: 我昨天晚上十点就回家了。
items.py: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang shí diǎn jiù huí jiā le.
items.en: I was home by ten last night (early).

items.zh: 我十二点半就到了，早到了一个小时。
items.py: Wǒ shí'èr diǎn bàn jiù dào le, zǎo dào le yí ge xiǎoshí.
items.en: I was there at half past twelve — an hour early.
生气 = angry (stronger than 不高兴). 告诉 = tell: 请告诉我你为什么来中国. 别 = don't, softer than 不要 (compare 'stay off the grass' with 'walking on the grass is forbidden').
see: 练习 · Practice (这么 / 以前 / 以后)

items.py: Jīnglǐ shēng qì le.
items.en: The manager got angry.

items.zh: 请告诉我你为什么来中国。
items.py: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ wèi shénme lái Zhōngguó.
items.en: Please tell me why you came to China.

items.py: Chī fàn de shíhou bié shuō huà.
items.en: Don't talk while eating.

items.zh: 写作业的时候别开电视。
items.py: Xiě zuòyè de shíhou bié kāi diànshì.
items.en: Don't turn on the TV while doing homework.
For the Christmas activity, bring things from home related to China or Asia to exchange or auction (拍卖).

items.zh: 我是一个中学老师，教学生画画儿。
items.py: Wǒ shì yī ge zhōngxué lǎoshī, jiāo xuésheng huà huàr.
items.en: I'm a middle-school teacher; I teach students to draw.

items.zh: 每次下课前，我都会把下次学生需要带的东西写在黑板上，但是每次上课时，总会有学生忘了拿铅笔，所以我有点儿生气，不是因为他们没带铅笔，是因为他们没有好的学习习惯。
items.py: Měi cì xià kè qián, wǒ dōu huì bǎ xià cì xuésheng xūyào dài de dōngxi xiě zài hēibǎn shang, dànshì měi cì shàng kè shí, zǒng huì yǒu xuésheng wàngle ná qiānbǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ yǒudiǎnr shēng qì, bù shì yīnwèi tāmen méi dài qiānbǐ, shì yīnwèi tāmen méiyǒu hǎo de xuéxí xíguàn.
items.en: Before the end of every class I write on the blackboard what students need to bring next time, but every class some students still forget their pencils. So I'm a bit angry, not because they didn't bring pencils, but because they don't have good study habits.
